game.title: Ankeliya
game.description: A ritualistic traditional game where two teams use forked sticks to hook and pull an iron ring, accompanied by ceremonies and drumming. Believed to bring prosperity.
howToPlay: Step 1: Two teams gather with specially prepared forked sticks.
Step 2: An iron ring is placed on the ground between them.
Step 3: Teams use their forked sticks to hook the ring.
Step 4: They attempt to pull the ring to their side.
Step 5: Ceremonies and drumming accompany the game.
Step 6: The game is believed to ensure good harvest.
Step 7: Requires teamwork and coordinated pulling.
Step 8: Spectators participate with chants and encouragement.
Step 9: Rituals are performed before and after the game.
